# CodexMeter 1.1.4
CodexMeter 1.1.4 turns the categorized menu bar overview into a compact, at-a-glance summary.
## Glanceable overview
- Input, Cached input, and Output now appear side by side directly under today's total. - This Week, This Month, and Local History or Lifetime now appear as a single comparable row. - The normal popover height shows Local Usage, Account Limits, Token History, and Explore together without unnecessary scrolling. - Detailed usage, project, session, limit, and period screens remain one click away. - Long token values scale within their summary cell instead of being cut off.
## Verification
- Complete Swift unit and integration suite: 143 tests passed, with two optional tests skipped - Native AppKit hosting-size and category-order regression tests - Impeccable layout detector completed without findings - Universal 2 architecture, bundle metadata, ad-hoc signature, archive, checksum, and Sparkle feed verification
## Install or update with Homebrew
```bash brew update brew upgrade --cask HechoLP/tap/codexmeter xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
Fresh installations can use `brew install --cask HechoLP/tap/codexmeter`.
## First direct-download launch
The app is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized. Download the DMG and `SHA256SUMS.txt` from the official release, verify the checksum, copy `CodexMeter.app` to Applications, and remove quarantine from this app only:
```bash cd ~/Downloads grep ' CodexMeter-1.1.4.dmg$' SHA256SUMS.txt | shasum -a 256 -c - xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
Do not remove quarantine when the checksum does not match the official manifest.
